hook: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google’s newest AI model for cybersecurity
hooks: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google’s newest AI model for cybersecurity
Google says the model beats other frontier models on security tests
Google says Gemini 4 Carbon scores 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for finding vulnerabilities
what_happened: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest AI model, which outperforms prior models on cybersecurity benchmarks and coding tasks.
why_it_matters: It lets cyber defenders generate secure code and patches faster, improving vulnerability detection and remediation.
the_catch: It is only available to a limited group of cyber defenders and trusted partners for now.
caption: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon model hits 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, showing strong vulnerability detection. Vulnerabilities or patches?
alt_text: The carousel explains Gemini 4 Carbon’s cybersecurity scores, its improvements over previous models, and its limited early access.
